purpose: Model sparse permitted interactions only when they improve the governed content-based baseline on future data.
limitations: Latent factors are associations and not human traits or causal effects.
Unseen sparse features cannot contribute until a new governed training version.
Synthetic improvement does not authorize production or shadow traffic.
The content-based baseline remains active unless every promotion gate passes.
rollback: Disable the FM signal and restore the governed content-based affinity score plus deterministic ranking fallback.
